meta.title: Quick Chat
meta.description: Puts one avatar per vendor in the conversation header (DeepSeek, Doubao, Gemini); clicking one slides that vendor's own web chat in from the right and the conversation makes room for it. The drawer is the site's real page, so sign-in, history, upload and voice input keep working. Two icon sets (vector glyphs or illustrated avatars), five colour schemes, one click sound per vendor, draggable width. No data is collected. Limits: sign-in does not survive a restart, and Google sign-in (Gemini by default) only works in the system browser.
